page.overview:
Who is Spy Clops?

8635 Mission 6: Mobile Command Center Agents HQ

Spy Clops is one of Dr. Inferno's henchman. He has four eyes and six legs made from made from 'robot arm' pieces with horns on the tips, much like the legs of a spider. In the 8635 Mission 6: Mobile Command Center he comes with black legs, but in 8634 Mission 5: Turbocar Chase he comes with unique silver legs. He looks something like a claw. Dr. Inferno created him to work for him. The first plot Inferno used him for was to stop Agent Chase in his Turbocar. Spy Clops succeeded and got the laptop information from Chase. Then Dr. Inferno enlisted his help to get him out of captivity from the Agents Mobile Command Center.

Cyborg spy with mechanical spider-legs and all-seeing robotic eyes.
